'''Convorees''' (singular: '''convor''') were yellow-feathered birds native to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].

==Biology and appearance==
Convorees were small avians native to the brier forests on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. They had short bodies with round heads and large eyes. They had a long curled tail to grip tree branches as well. They used teamwork to defeat one of their predators, the [[Momong/Legends|momong]], by dropping them off the limbs of trees.<ref name="WH" />

They were remarkably similar in appearance to [[Kiros bird/Legends|Kiros birds]], but with different-colored plumage.<ref name="SW-Kidnapped - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep411|text="Kidnapped" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide"|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref>

These creatures were commonly adopted as pets, such as in the case of [[Aedalus]], [[Erial]] and [[Vector (convor)|Vector]].<ref name="game">{{TCWA|set=Convor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The convor also appears on a hand-posted bill created for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'']] episode ''[[Missing in Action]]''; however, although the document can be seen behind the counter in the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] diner, it is too far away to actually see the pictures and the text. According to the episode's Trivia Gallery on [[StarWars.com]], the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] caption says:<br />
::"[[Trandosha/Legends|TRANDOSHAN]] BIRD. BRING HOME THIS ADORABLE [[Bird/Legends|BIRD]] AND BRIGHTEN YOUR [[Standard day/Legends|DAY]]. BETTER WHEN YOU BUY TWO" . "60 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|R. C.]]"<ref name="SW-Missing in Action - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep512|text="Missing in Action" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 9}}</ref>
